title: fix(plugin-grid): leave a raw aggregate over a record-mode quantity out of the whole-set footer and group headers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_
Fixes #36082

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表和表格分页时,底部合计行不再把「按行单位的数量」(一行千克、一行磅)的求和、平均、最小、最大放进整表合计查询;该列只显示计数,其他列照常显示整个视图的合计。
- 属于「数量带单位」上线前的收尾:引擎已拒绝不按单位分组的这类求和,不做这一步,整条合计查询被拒,其他列会悄悄退回成本页合计。
- 出错的话,影响的只是表格底部和分组标题里的数字;可直接撤回本改动,不涉及数据。
- 无。

## What changes

One rule in `recordCurrencyAggregates.ts`, two readers: a raw `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over a measure whose unit each record names itself needs the rows grouped by that unit's field.

- `recordUnitField(def)` reads a `record`-mode quantity exactly as the engine door `recordUnitFieldOf` does (`packages/objectql/src/record-unit-aggregate-door.ts`): a `number` with `unitConfig.unitMode === 'record'` and a non-empty `unitField`.
- `recordMeasureUnitField(def)` = the currency code field (`recordCurrencyField` from `@object-ui/i18n`, unchanged) or that unit field.
- `requiredCurrencyGrouping` becomes `requiredAggregateGrouping` and `isMoneyAggregate` becomes `isMeasureAggregate` (module-internal, not in the package barrel); the aggregate set stays one constant.
- Readers, all through that one helper: `wholeSetSummaryNodes` (the whole-set footer query leaves the node out), `honestGroupAggregations` (a group aggregate stands only when grouped by the unit field), `useScopedColumnSummary` (the footer cell draws nothing for it, as for a record-mode amount) and `offeredColumnSummaries` (the footer menu offers the count family only).
- No engine, no `packages/spec` change. No new per-unit total.

## Tests

- `recordCurrencyAggregates-27188.test.tsx`, new top-level describe for the quantity: footer draws no sum / avg / min / max and the count stands; fixed-mode and plain-number controls sum; the menu offers no aggregate; group aggregates stand grouped by `unit_code` and drop otherwise; the predicate's edges (empty `unitField`, non-`number` type).
- `footerSummaryScope-12081.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (the double now refuses a record-mode quantity aggregate as the engine does): a view with a record-mode quantity `sum` beside a plain-number `sum` sends one query carrying only `count` and `sum_amount`, the plain column shows its whole-set figure, the quantity column shows nothing, zero refusals. Control: a `fixed`-mode quantity is asked and totals over the whole set.
- Ablations (one per leg, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restore proven by blob hash): see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- Group headers at a shallower depth (out of scope, for the seat): `honestGroupAggregations` keeps a measure aggregate when the unit or code field is at ANY grouping level, and `useServerGrouping` asks each depth with the first `depth` grouping fields. Measured with the spec's `compileListViewGroupQuery`: grouping `region` then `unit_code` with a `sum` over `qty` compiles depth 1 to `groupBy: ["region"]` carrying `sum_qty`, which the engine's unit door (and the currency door, for a record-mode amount) refuses. This PR keeps the currency precedent's rule unchanged and applies it to quantities, as the card ordered.
- The shared test files were extended instead of a new card-named file: the root rule puts a new pin for a component with a shared harness file into that file as a top-level describe.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/recordCurrencyAggregates.ts`: `recordUnitField` must match the engine door's reading.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts`: the leave-out line in `wholeSetSummaryNodes`.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts`: the footer skip and `offeredColumnSummaries`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/recordCurrencyAggregates-27188.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/footerSummaryScope-12081.test.tsx` from the repo root; expect 42 passed.

Readings (source tree at 9f56bc1948; the test runs were taken at ae56a75b37, whose sources are byte-identical, the later commit adds only the changeset):

<details><summary>Pin files and the plugin-grid suite</summary>

- `vitest run` of the two pin files: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 42 passed (42).
- `vitest run packages/plugin-grid/`: Test Files 300 passed (300), Tests 2657 passed (2657); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (tsc on src and on `tsconfig.test.json`, which lists both pin files): VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations, one per leg</summary>

Each mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed), restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The subject resolves to `src` (relative imports), so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.

- Shared predicate (`?? recordUnitField(def)` removed): 5 failed / 37 passed, exactly the five quantity pins; every currency pin and control stays green. A first attempt was refused by the tool (the replacement was a bare semicolon, whose count could not rise); it ran nothing and is not counted.
- Whole-set leave-out (the `continue` in `wholeSetSummaryNodes` removed): 5 failed / 25 passed, the four record-currency pins and the quantity whole-set pin.
- Footer cell skip disabled: 5 failed / 37 passed, the two footer pins (amount, quantity) and the three whole-set pins (two currency, one quantity): the left-out column falls back to a page sum over mixed units.
- Footer menu (`offeredColumnSummaries`) disabled: 1 failed / 11 passed, the quantity menu pin.
- Group filter (`honestGroupAggregations` keeps all): 2 failed / 10 passed, the currency and the quantity drop pins.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gate subset</summary>

Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (38 commands); all 38 exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` queue-timed out twice on the shared verify lock (exit 99), then passed on the third attempt after the PR was opened: 172 files passed, 2 skipped; 5122 tests passed. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first queue-timed out, then exit 0 on retry. Outside the list: `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (no anchored file), `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations` 0 new. `overlap-check` VERDICT clean.

</details>
